title: Mobile navigation and public-page redesign
body:
- Phones and tablets use a compact header with a scrollable modal navigation menu; desktop navigation remains available.
- The homepage puts the daily puzzle first, with an interactive globe and expandable game, rule, and device-progress sections.
- Blog search, filters, article facts, trivia, and sharing use simplified responsive layouts, including an Americas filter that covers both North and South America.
- Map controls are more compact on phones, and the question inspector stacks its tabs with independently scrollable code panels.
- Guest progress and public navigation include improved English and Polish labels.

The release also retains the previously prepared disk-backed caches, desktop question-focus restoration, and stricter country-guess validation. Saved progress, puzzle targets, and game limits are unchanged.
